description: Haseeb Waqas Sugar Mills Limited is a public limited sugar company incorporated in 1991, part of the Haseeb Waqas Group. Its mill at Nankana Sahib, about 100 km from the group's head office in Lahore, crushes up to 10,000 metric tons of cane a day over a 160-day season and produces white refined sugar. The company states that it introduced split cane carriers and pressure feeders to the Pakistani sugar industry, and that its milling tandem and pressure evaporation system were developed in-house by Haseeb Waqas Engineering.
